liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Shakedown Street** (1 review): Slower tempo and pitch drop after Playin' made it nearly unlistenable [19]

## Setlist highlights

- **Teddy Bear's Picnic tuning**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [25]

## The recordings

- **gd1981-10-02.151771.sbd.hance.sirmick.flac24** (recommended): soundboard; 23 songs; 165 min [1]
- **gd1981-10-02.151770.sbd.hance.sirmick.flac16**: soundboard; 23 songs; 165 min [2]
- **gd1981-10-02.151194.sbd.hance.sirmick.flac24**: soundboard; 23 songs; 167 min [3]
- **gd1981-10-02.aud.unknown.sirmick.80289.sbeok.flac16**: audience recording; 23 songs; 165 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [5]. Said about its sound: Mama Tried start clipped; Bertha cut; US Blues right channel dropout fixed [5]
- **gd81-10-02.sbd.popi.6147.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 154 min; rated 3.07/5 by 14 [10]. Said about its sound: Lossless download worked without corruption warnings; sound and performance rated excellent; Playin' and Shakedown plagued with sound problems, cuts, and crappy patches [14][21]

## Around the show

- Open floor allowed walking to stage; early sound was poor up front [16]
- Reviewer describes venue as ornate with killer balcony over stage [18]
- Relaxed atmosphere allowed audience to rest elbows on stage edge [20]
- Bob Weir blew audience away; band never same after Pig Pen died [22]
- Playin' to Shakedown transition with Brent occurred only three times total [24]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1981-10-02.151771.sbd.hance.sirmick.flac24**: taped by Unknown; tape supplied by John Hance; transferred by John Hance and SIRMick; source: Soundboard Cassette (1st gen) [1]. Also: Remaster pitch-corrected with Joe B Jones help; three songs patched [1]
- **gd1981-10-02.151770.sbd.hance.sirmick.flac16**: taped by John Hance; transferred by John Hance & SIRMick; source: Soundboard Cassette (1st gen) [2]. Also: Remaster pitch-corrected with Joe B Jones help; three songs patched [2]
- **gd1981-10-02.151194.sbd.hance.sirmick.flac24**: transferred by John Hance and SIRMick; source: Soundboard Cassette (1st gen) [3]. Also: Missing Dire Wolf end and next two tracks patched from Peter Williams cassette [3]
- **gd1981-10-02.aud.unknown.sirmick.80289.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by SIRMick; source: aud > low gen cass > Wavelab > wav > flac [5]
- **gd81-10-02.sbd.popi.6147.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [10]
